long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The dusk restlessness has to go somewhere, and the lookout rock is a good place to run toward.
The moon is up now, and I want to put down what its colour looks like before anyone else does.
steps.topic: the moon's colour through the telescope

today.reason: Hunger cannot be fixed until the bowl is filled in the morning, so I will spend the dusk on zoomies and then on the telescope.
